primary_endpoint: type_normalized_pm100 (released Precise Matching == 100 after digit-string canonicalization; ground-truth subtask coverage, not strict sequence equality)

symbolic_endpoint_tiers.pm100: vlabench_pm100_match: released graph matcher; predicted actions outside the evaluator vocabulary and predicted subtasks beyond the reference count are not inspected, so surplus actions can still score 100
symbolic_endpoint_tiers.strict: strict_sequence_equal: normalized predicted sequence == normalized reference sequence in length, skill names, order, and target keys/values
symbolic_endpoint_tiers.strict_executor_filtered: strict_sequence_equal after removing executor-only phase names (moveto, wait, open_gripper, move_offset) that have no counterpart in the symbolic evaluator vocabulary; a sensitivity for projection residue, not a repair of the model output

default: identity projection; preserve emitted order, skill labels, and targets

insert_tasks.mapping: drop lift; relabel each emitted moveto(target) as insert(target); preserve all other emitted actions
insert_tasks.rationale: source-derived macro projection from the executor phase vocabulary to the symbolic contract

add_condiment_tasks.mapping: drop lift; consume exactly one emitted moveto target as the emitted pour target; preserve all other emitted actions
